summary.text: Chris Stock is the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He won the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, defeating Cheryl Caulfield with 60.6% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Stock said his campaign centers on quality of life, lowering the cost of living and public safety, and he listed preventing a toll on Capital Boulevard among his priorities.
He said he would pursue tax credits for first-time homebuyers and small business owners, enhance North Carolina's child tax credit, and end cashless bail.
He named Senators Brent Jackson and Bill Rabon, former Lieutenant Governor Dan Forest and Agriculture Commissioner Steve Troxler as endorsers.
